Title: Validate cost and scale-to-zero dev configuration
Description: As a DevOps engineer, I want the dev cost profile and scale-to-zero configuration validated so that spending stays under the approved budget and is documented for billing and forecasting. The work confirms scale-to-zero is working for idle Container Apps, Cosmos DB is on minimal RUs, and all basic-tier SKUs are in use, then estimates the cost of the 100-doc load test, confirms it is acceptable, and documents the cost breakdown.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dev Container Apps scale to zero after idle timeout
Cosmos DB RU/s is set to minimal and scales down when not in use
AI Foundry, AI Search, and Service Bus are on basic/standard tiers
Monthly dev cost estimate is within approved budget
100-doc load test cost is estimated and logged
Scale-to-zero is confirmed to be working (verified via Azure portal or CLI)
Cost breakdown report is generated and documented
TalkingPoints: I'm going to validate the cost profile of dev and the 100-doc batch. I'll confirm scale-to-zero is active, basic SKUs are in use, and spending is under budget. I'm going to document costs for billing and forecasting.

Tasks.Title: Verify scale-to-zero is configured and working
Tasks.Description: Check Container Apps config, trigger scale-down by going idle, verify instances hit zero.

Tasks.Title: Verify Cosmos DB and other resource SKUs are minimal
Tasks.Description: Check Azure portal for resource tier and capacity settings; confirm minimal configs.

Tasks.Title: Generate cost analysis from Azure Cost Management
Tasks.Description: Pull usage and cost data; create monthly estimate and breakdown by service.

Tasks.Title: Document load test cost and confirm approval
Tasks.Description: Estimate cost for 100-doc batch; confirm it is acceptable for the demo.
